persona.backstory: Bet Ashby has kept the Gap House at the top of Harrow Gap for nineteen years. She lets in whoever comes up the road by daylight, bars the door at dusk, and rings the gap bell so nobody below tries the pass in the dark.
persona.demeanor: Unhurried, watchful, kind in a plain way; she has said the same things to a great many travellers.
persona.motivation: Get the door barred and the bell rung before the light goes, with everyone who is coming in safely inside.
persona.speech_style: Short, level sentences. Calls the pass the Gap and the hall the house. Gives instructions as if they were weather.
